{{Top|leg}}
'''Methyl''' was a type of substance present on the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ostfrei]] in the vicinity of a [[Ostfrei pirate base|concealed pirate base]] that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?">{{LivingForce|Who Goes Thaere?}}</ref>

{{RPG|''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]''}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance]] agents were hired by the [[Tarasin]] [[Senator/Legends|senatorial]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Sa'arli]] to investigate reports of suspicious activity on Ostfrei. The freelancers tracked the location of the hidden [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base by using a portable [[chemical scanner]] to follow a trail of ionized methyl and [[carbonyl]] ions that led to the facility.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Methyl featured in the [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] module ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'', which was written by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] and formed part of Year Three of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying campaign. In ''Who Goes Thaere?'', the players roleplay as the freelance agents sent to Ostfrei and it is possible for them to locate the hidden pirate base on the moon by tracking a trail of methyl.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
